title: Details of Collected Information
subtitle: A detailed explanation of each type of information we collect and the reasons for collecting it

auth.title: Full Name and Email Address upon Registration

details.0: The full name is used to display your identity in your profile and in interactions with content
details.1: The email address is necessary for account authentication and sending important notifications
details.2: All data is encrypted and stored securely in the database

details.0: Helps in displaying content appropriate for your academic level
details.1: Makes it easier to find summaries and materials related to your department
details.2: Improves the accuracy of suggestions and recommended content

summaries.title: Summaries and Academic Resources You Upload

details.0: The content you upload is saved to be shared with other students
details.1: Helps in building a comprehensive and useful study library
details.2: The quality of content is verified before being published to everyone

interactions.title: Comments, Ratings, and Interactions with Content

details.0: Helps in understanding user opinions and improving content
details.1: Builds an interactive and useful study community
details.2: Helps in identifying the highest quality and most useful content

performance.title: Performance Data in Tests and Exams
performance.purpose: Tracking Academic Progress and Improving Learning

details.0: Helps in analyzing strengths and weaknesses in different subjects
details.1: Provides useful statistics to improve study habits
details.2: Maintains the confidentiality of results and is not shared with others

profileImage.title: Profile Picture (if added to your profile)

details.0: Your picture appears in your profile and in comments and interactions
details.1: Helps in building a reliable personal identity in the study community
details.2: Can be deleted or changed at any time from profile settings

commitment.title: Our Commitment to Security and Privacy
commitment.content1: All collected information is protected by the latest encryption and security technologies. We do not use your data for commercial purposes or share it with third parties.
commitment.content2: You can request the deletion of your data or modify privacy settings at any time through your profile page.
